proposal.name: Hold modeled builds with driver review problems

plan.name: Hold modeled builds with driver review problems
plan.summary: Refine D-0082 so a modeled build whose driver or Go explorer review reports a problem stays a draft for a person: D-0483 and D-0183 explain why review must stop automatic merging when the driver can tamper with its own process or substitute application behavior. The read-only reviewer returns one JSON object with a required boolean approved and nonempty string text, and synth.Review persists Approved as approved alongside its existing text, usage and subject; only a successfully completed, valid result can approve, while missing, malformed, ambiguous or unfinished responses and review execution errors cannot approve, regardless of approval-like words in the text. Publish findings or the reason review could not finish above the receipt, label the issue and pull request for human review, and preserve the hold and review spend through saved-result recovery without changing the gate receipt; this deliberately replaces both the current ready publication after adverse or failed review and the current no-publication behavior when only the reviewer exhausts its provider retries after synthesis has passed, while synthesis provider failures still publish nothing and projects with no driver or explorer still require no review. A completed approving review keeps the existing CI-gated merge path, and held modeled drafts keep existing human-merge, retry and revise behavior: a writer's retry watches the same pull request without rebuilding or reviewing again and may mark it ready and merge after the current head passes CI, subject to existing trusted-base holds, while revise requires closing the open pull request before drafting and ratifying again. Update SPEC.md, the README within its 400-line limit, docs/factory.md and docs/gate.md to describe the review hold, the reviewer-provider exception and these commands, citing D-0082, D-0483 and this ratified plan as the decision record, with changed SPEC bullets linking [#933's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-933.json).

tests.name: TestDriverReview933RequiresStructuredCompletion
tests.says: Only a complete structured reviewer result can approve; findings and approval are separate from prose, invalid or failed results cannot approve, and the review remains read-only with usage retained.

tests.name: TestModeledReview933ControlsPublication
tests.says: A review reporting problems or failing to complete leaves an open draft with findings first and human-review labels despite a passing gate, while a structured approval keeps ordinary CI-gated merging.

tests.name: TestModeledReview933SurvivesPublicationRecovery
tests.says: A replacement watcher recovers a saved adverse review before or after pull-request creation without another build, a duplicate pull request, or readiness or merging after CI succeeds.

tests.name: TestModeledReview933KeepsHumanCommands
tests.says: Held modeled builds still permit a person's merge, an authorized retry of the same draft without a new review, and revise after closure, while unprivileged commands and retries of trusted projects cannot bypass human control.
